rollback.sql:
ALTER TRIGGER [reporting].[ReportingGlobalResource_AfterDelete] ON [reporting].[Global_Resource] FOR DELETE AS SET NOCOUNT ON; INSERT INTO [queue].[Task] ([Action], [Custom], [Object], [ObjectID]) select 'Delete', [queue].WriteIndexXml('Removed', 'Resource', ResourceID, 0), 'Resource', ResourceID from deleted;
delete Asset where Object = 'Resource' and ObjectID in (select ResourceID from deleted); GO
ALTER TRIGGER [reporting].[ReportingGlobalResource_AfterUpsert] ON [reporting].[Global_Resource] FOR INSERT, UPDATE AS SET NOCOUNT ON; IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM DELETED) BEGIN INSERT INTO [queue].[Task] ([Action], [Custom], [Object], [ObjectID]) select 'Add', [queue].WriteIndexXml('', 'Resource', ResourceID, 0), 'Resource', ResourceID from inserted; END
merge dbo.Asset as T using ( SELECT T.ID as AssetTypeID, 1 as [State], O.ResourceID as SourceID, 'Resource' as Object, O.ResourceID as ObjectID, O.[uid] FROM inserted O inner join AssetType T on T.Object = 'ResourceType' and T.ObjectID = 1 ) as S on (T.Object = S.Object and T.ObjectID = S.ObjectID) when matched then update set T.[uid] = S.[uid], T.UpdatedOn = getutcdate(), T.UpdatedBy = 0 when not matched by target then insert ([AssetTypeID], [State], SourceID, [Object], [ObjectID],[CreatedOn],[CreatedBy],[UpdatedOn],[UpdatedBy],[uid]) values (S.[AssetTypeID], S.[State], S.SourceID, S.[Object], S.[ObjectID], getutcdate(), 0, getutcdate(), 0, S.[uid]); GO
